title: NetworkMachineRevokedPayload
description: network.machine.revoked v1 (OpenVibe.Network, plan L34: the machines hub). A machine of a person was revoked: it is no longer theirs and its credential is dead. The machine's credential and its hash are never carried. A second revoke changes nothing and emits nothing. Envelope: subject { type: machine, id: <dev_…> }, visibility internal, actor service:network.

principal_id.description: The machine's node principal on Network, when it had one.

owner.description: The person the machine belonged to.

reason.description: Why it was revoked, when the caller gave one. Absent otherwise.
